notes: Badge list (53), thresholds, height ranges, descriptions & token costs: NBA 2K27 data from NBA2KLab, cross-checked by my2kbuilder (all cells marked cross_checked).
Legend cannot be unlocked at creation; only via Synergy boosts (official 2K MyPLAYER Builder page).
Playstyle tags and priority scoring are this app's own heuristic — not from 2K or creators.

text: 16 Synergy slots in 8 Fuse/Reaction pairs (official: 16 total, +1 or +2). Split of six +1 pairs and two +2 pairs is community-reported (NBA2KLab, lockercodes, ANF builder).
Fuse badge: permanent +1/+2 tier for the whole game and costs 0 tokens.
Reaction badge: gets the same boost after its Fuse triggers enough times in a game; still costs tokens. Each Fuse allows only certain Reactions.
+1 turns Gold→HoF or HoF→Legend; +2 turns Gold→Legend.
Unlocks: Season 1 rewards (4 pairs, expire at season end), Crew Lv 28 & 39 (+1, permanent), Build Specialization Goal 10 (+2, permanent; Fuse must match discipline), REP Legend II (+2, permanent).
Cap Breakers unlock once the build reaches 99 OVR.
Up to 5 per attribute, 28 total per build across all sources (incl. Build Specialization).
Each breaker adds a variable boost (bigger when the stat is lower), never above the body's max for that stat. Exact per-breaker amounts are NOT modeled in this app.

slots.text: Every build starts with 20 badge slots across six disciplines; badges are equipped with Badge Tokens (official 2K).

badges.name: Arc Cadence
badges.description: Improves a player's ability to knock down 3-point shots on the move, including pull-ups, hop-steps, or spin shots.

badges.name: Deadeye
badges.description: Jump shots taken with a defender closing out receive less of a penalty from a shot contest.

badges.name: Limitless Range
badges.description: Extends the range from which a player can shoot 3PT shots effectively from deep.

badges.name: Mini Marksman
badges.description: Shorter shooters are less bothered by lengthy defenders.

badges.name: Post Fade Phenom
badges.description: Improves ability to make post fades and hop shots.

badges.name: Quick Trigger
badges.description: Improves a player's ability to make no-dip jump shots.

badges.name: Set and Fire
badges.description: Applies a shooting boost to 3-point shots when the player's feet are completely set.

badges.name: Smooth Operator
badges.description: Improves a player's ability to knock down mid-range shots on the move, including pull-ups, hop-steps, or spin shots.

badges.name: Static Middy
badges.description: Applies a shooting boost to stand-still mid-range shots.

badges.name: Ankle Assassin
badges.description: Increases the ability to break down the defender and cross them up.

badges.name: Bail Out
badges.description: Passing out of a jump shot or layup yields fewer errant passes than normal. Additionally helps passing out of double teams.

badges.name: Break Starter
badges.description: After grabbing a defensive rebound, deep outlet passes made up the court are more accurate. Passes must be made quickly following the defensive rebound.

badges.name: Dimer
badges.description: Boosts the shot percentage for open teammates after catching a pass.

badges.name: Handles for Days
badges.description: Allows a player to take less of an energy hit when performing consecutive dribble moves.

badges.name: Lightning Launch
badges.description: Speeds up launches when attacking from the perimeter.

badges.name: Pace
badges.description: Raises the speed of the ball handler when sprinting.

badges.name: Strong Handle
badges.description: Reduces the likelihood of being bothered by defenders when dribbling.

badges.name: Unpluckable
badges.description: Defenders have a tougher time poking the ball free with their steal attempts.

badges.name: Versatile Visionary
badges.description: Improves a player's ability to thread and fire tight passes, including alley-oops, quickly and on time.

badges.name: Aerial Wizard
badges.description: Increases ability to finish an alley-oop dunk from a teammate, or an in-air putback dunk off an offensive rebound.

badges.name: Float Game
badges.description: Increases a player's ability to finish floaters.

badges.name: Ghost Stepper
badges.description: Increases the effectiveness of step-through layups or other close-range shots that come after a shot fake.

badges.name: Hook Specialist
badges.description: Improves ability to make post hooks.

badges.name: Layup Mixmaster
badges.description: Improves a player's ability to finish fancy or acrobatic layups.

badges.name: Paint Prodigy
badges.description: Improves a player's ability to quickly and effectively score while going to work in the paint.

badges.name: Physical Finisher
badges.description: Improves a player's ability to battle through contact and convert contact layups.

badges.name: Post Powerhouse
badges.description: Strengthens a player's ability at backing down defenders and moving them with drop steps.

badges.name: Post Spin Catalyst
badges.description: Attempting post spins or drives results in more effective moves and less of a chance to be stripped.

badges.name: Posterizer
badges.description: Increases the chances of throwing down a dunk on your defender while driving to the hoop.

badges.name: Rise Up
badges.description: Increases the likelihood of dunking on your opponent when standing in the painted area.

badges.name: Ankle Braces
badges.description: Lowers the likelihood of getting ankle-broken by opposing dribble moves.

badges.name: Challenger
badges.description: Improves the effectiveness of well-timed contests against perimeter shooters.

badges.name: Glove
badges.description: Increases the ability to successfully steal from ball handlers or strip layup attempts.

badges.name: High-Flying Denier
badges.description: Boosts the speed and leaping ability of a defensive player in anticipation of a chase-down block attempt.

badges.name: Immovable Enforcer
badges.description: Improves a defensive player's strength when defending ball handlers and finishers coming straight at them.

badges.name: Interceptor
badges.description: The frequency of successfully tipped or intercepted passes greatly increases.

badges.name: Off-Ball Pest
badges.description: Makes players more difficult to get past when playing off-ball, as they can grab and hold their matchup.

badges.name: Paint Patroller
badges.description: Increases a player's ability to block or contest shots at the rim.

badges.name: Pick Dodger
badges.description: Improves a player's ability to navigate through and around screens while on defense.

badges.name: Post Lockdown
badges.description: Strengthens a player's ability to effectively defend moves in the post, with an increased chance of stripping the opponent.

badges.name: Seatbelt
badges.description: Boost body-up defense effectiveness, making it easier to clamp opponents and disrupt their drive path.

badges.name: Wall Up
badges.description: Improves shot contest effectiveness during hands-up defense when guarding the paint.

badges.name: Boxout Boss
badges.description: Improves the effectiveness of boxouts as the boxer.

badges.name: Breaker
badges.description: Increases the success rate of breaking through opponent boxouts.

badges.name: Crasher
badges.description: Boost a player's ability to track down or grab rebounds on the offensive end.

badges.name: Possession Closer
badges.description: Boost a player's ability to grab rebounds on the defensive end.

badges.name: Sync Snatcher
badges.description: Gives an additional Vertical and Rebounding boost when perfectly timing the jump.

badges.name: Brick Wall
badges.description: Increases the effectiveness of screens.

badges.name: Bruiser
badges.description: Drains energy from opponents when making physical contact.

badges.name: Flash
badges.description: Speeds up movement without the ball while in transition on offense or defense.

badges.name: Pogo Stick
badges.description: Allows players to quickly go back up for another jump upon landing. This applies after a rebound, block attempt, or jump shot.

badges.name: Slippery Off-Ball
badges.description: When attempting to get open off screens, the player more effectively navigates through traffic.

badges.name: Work Horse
badges.description: Increases a player's speed and ability to get loose balls over the opponent.

shooter.note: Top catch-and-shoot 3PT badge; S-tier in community lists, Gold on NBA2KLab's Day-1 PG build.
Silver is the cost-effective tier (deep range unlocked); Gold+ adds little per meta guide.
Disputed: timesaver ranks it top for contested shots; MMOexp says Bronze/Silver is enough.
Solid secondary for mid-range/fade shooters; Silver–Gold.
Cheap (55 Mid unlocks Bronze) set-feet mid-range boost; Silver–Gold.
Guards 6'4" and under only; Gold on NBA2KLab PG build.
Community says poor value for its token cost — equip last.

playmaker.note: Core guard badge; NBA2KLab's top Max +1 target (Gold→HoF).
Core meta burst badge; Gold at 86 Speed w/ Ball.
Part of the "core four" guard combo.
Best passing badge for teammates' shooting; key for point forwards.

slasher.note: Lob / putback finishing; Gold on NBA2KLab PG build.
Burst off the perimeter to get to the rim.

lockdown.note: NBA2KLab's top Max +1 target on lockdown builds (Gold→HoF).
NBA2KLab Max+ target; Silver is a solid baseline.
Silver is enough per meta guide.

post.note: Sept 17 update made Gold+ meaningfully stronger.

rim_protector.note: Blocks/contests at rim (Gold at 77 IntD + 93 Blk).

recNotes: NBA2KLab's own 2K27 badge effectiveness tests were still marked "Test pending" on nba2klab.com/badges when this data was compiled (Oct 12, 2026). NBA2KLab picks here come from its Recommended Builds pages (Max +1/+2 targets and badge unlocks), not lab test percentages.
Community sources (tier lists, Reddit, build sites) sometimes disagree; conflicts are noted per badge.
Mode adjustments, loadout ordering and the 20-slot fill are this app's estimate. Per-discipline slot limits are not modeled.
